text: Healthy living means taking care of both your body and your mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and avoid too much sugar and fast food. Second, try to exercise regularly—even a short walk every day can help. Good sleep is also important, so aim for seven to eight hours each night. Don't forget your mental health: talk to friends and family when you feel stressed. Finally, keep a good work-life balance by making time for rest and hobbies. Small daily habits like these can make a big difference to how you feel.
